researchNotes: Shopify store: /products.json was too large to read in full, so the range came from the US collection feeds /en-us/collections/eaux-de-parfum/products.json (26 items), /collections/les-essences-de-diptyque/products.json (7) and /collections/eaux-de-toilette/products.json (30), read via us.diptyqueparis.com. Each fragrance uses its own official product page as the only source. Included the core 100/75 ml eaux de parfum, Eau de Parfum Intense flankers (Benjoin Bohème, Eau Nabati, Eau Rihla), the Les Essences de Diptyque line, and the core eaux de toilette. Entries with the same name in different concentrations are separate entries. Skipped sets, holiday editions, large formats, candles, room sprays and body care. Notes are reported as one list on every page, so top/heart/base are empty. Year and perfumer only where a page states them. Country not stated on the pages read. Not read: any discontinued Diptyque fragrances, which the feeds do not list.

fragrances.name: Do Son

sources.name: Diptyque US - Do Son Eau de Parfum
Venba — Diptyque Do Son EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: two listings and a Vivir EDP review give 4-6 h on skin, one retailer 6-8 h; sillage moderate and non-intrusive. Most common view used; EDT and solid versions excluded.
